recommendedAlgorithm.status: Official data gives the ingredients (templates, special entries, weights, halves, factors, min/max replaced count); the exact server algorithm is not public. Steps marked [ASSUMED] are a reconstruction consistent with every field.
recommendedAlgorithm.1_matchSetup: Pick stage map by stageDatasDict weight for the mode (05-maps.json stageSelection). Pick specialEnemyNum=3 distinct factions from FLY/TIMES/ELEMENT/DOT/INVISIBLE/REFLECTION with weight 3 each (training: constData.trSpecialEnemyTypes = FLY,TIMES,ELEMENT). SPECIAL (count -1) is always in the pool. Drop entries listed in modeDataDict[mode].inactiveEnemyKey. Pick the boss for round 14 among battleDataDict candidates by bossInfoDict.weight (boss_5 weight 10, others 5-6); round 15 (hidden core) among boss_8/9/10 (weights 50/40/40).
recommendedAlgorithm.2_perRoundEntry: [ASSUMED] For each non-boss round r: half = firstHalf if r<=7 (templates 01-07) else secondHalf (h01-h06). Ground entry G = weighted pick (randomWeight) among specialEntries whose type is a chosen non-FLY faction or SPECIAL and whose firstHalf matches. Fly entry F = weighted pick among FLY entries of that half if FLY was chosen, else none.
recommendedAlgorithm.3_replace: Template keys in the round level are placeholders: enemy_1425_lrcmra(S)->G.key, enemy_1422_lrsldr(N)->random of G.N, enemy_1427_lrnazg(E)->random of G.E; if F: enemy_1040_bombd(SF)->F.key, enemy_1005_yokai(NF)->random F.N, enemy_1042_frostd(EF)->random F.E, else fly slots keep yokai/frostd/bombd. Literal keys (enemy_1007_slime in round 1, boss-level extras) are kept. [ASSUMED] each replaced template enemy becomes k copies, k=clamp(round(be(template)/be(new)),1,5) (precomputed in specialEntries rows); spawn interval unchanged, extra copies spawn together with ~0.5s stagger.
recommendedAlgorithm.4_bounties: Rest phase of spPrepare rounds (3,6,9,11 depending on mode; see schedule) offers 机变阶段 choices: BOUNTY_HUNT (悬赏决策) adds bountyEffects enemies to the chooser's next battle(s); kill_gain_coin pays the killer, selfbattle_win_gain_coin pays if the chooser's own combat phase is perfect. 战术特训 bounty enemies have HP/ATK/DEF x0.7 in single mode (patch note).
recommendedAlgorithm.5_statScaling: Raw level-0 stats are used (randomEnemyAttributeDict level 0). Difficulty is driven by template counts (2 enemies R1 -> ~70 R12-13), second-half upgraded entries and inactiveEnemyKey. Season enemy stat effects exist (enemyStatEffects: aceffect_enemy_1..5) but are applied server-side with no public mapping. [ASSUMED proposal] FUNNY: aceffect_enemy_5 (ATK x0.7, HP x0.75); NORMAL: aceffect_enemy_4 (ATK x0.8, HP x0.8); HARD: x1.0; ABYSS: aceffect_enemy_3 (ATK x1.1, HP x1.2) + aceffect_enemy_1 (move +15%). Rounds 8-13 add aceffect_enemy_2 (HP x1.08), rounds 11-13 use aceffect_enemy_2_2 (HP x1.2) instead. 9012_acloon (炎佑) and 召唤物 are always excluded (enemy_exclude lists).
recommendedAlgorithm.6_bossRound: Round 14 (FUNNY: 9) uses rows 1-5 of the stage; boss level *_s for single, non-_s for multi (2 players per boss battlefield; 4-player lobby = 2 battlefields). Boss HP = bosses[id].bloodPoint[difficulty] (FUNNY/NORMAL/HARD/ABYSS) as ONE pool shared by every player/battlefield ("所有人将一起对敌方领袖造成伤害"; boss_battle_multi_player branch spawns a mirrored copy sharing HP). [ASSUMED] single mode uses the same pool value. Combat lasts until boss dies or LP hits 0; after bossTurnHpReduceTime=150s each second costs 1 LP.
recommendedAlgorithm.7_hiddenCore: Round 15 only in NORMAL/HARD/ABYSS: single requires total activated bond layers >300 and LP >1; multi requires all players' activated bond layers sum >1000 and combined LP >1 (PRTS). Bosses boss_8/9/10 (假想敌：胄/铳/管 2nd forms, isHidingBoss).

lifePointRules.normalRound: Combat phase ends when every enemy is dead or battleTime (template maxPlayTime) expires; enemies still alive at timeout count as leaked. Perfect clear = 0 leaked. Single: LP -= min(costPlayerHpLimit=10, leakedCount). Official help: "根据未击倒敌人的数量，扣除其所属玩家的目标生命值（每回合最多扣除10点）". [ASSUMED] leakedCount counts each unkilled enemy as 1 (lifePointReduce is NOT used in normal rounds, since several regular faction enemies have lpr 0) excluding notCountInTotal units and boss-part summons.
lifePointRules.multiUnitePhase: Team mode: leaked enemies do not cost LP immediately. If >=1 player leaked and >=1 player cleared perfectly, 联防阶段: up to 2 perfect-clear players fight the union of all leaked enemies with their current board (template level_act1autochess_escaped_multi: 8 routes, one SPAWN slot per template category N,E,S,NF,EF,SF,T,TF, up to 5 each, entering from the partner side (9,18)/(12,18) and crossing to (9,2)). Enemies that also survive the unite phase cost their original owners LP (cap 10 per player per round). If nobody cleared perfectly, leaks cost LP instantly. Bonds do not stack during 联防.
lifePointRules.bossRound: Round 14/15: all players' LP merge into one pool, no 10-LP cap. After 150s overtime, -1 LP per second. [ASSUMED] each enemy reaching an end costs its lifePointReduce (bosses 2, 卢西恩 30, most others 1).
lifePointRules.loss: LP <= 0 -> eliminated (single: run over; multi: shared pool in boss round -> team loss). [ASSUMED for normal rounds in multi: a player at 0 LP is out.]
